arrival.text: The tent is still here. Good. One thing that stayed where I left it.
Go, then. She said it so quietly I almost thought she was asking me to stay.
I'm not hiding from her. I am waiting where she has to choose to come.

cups.text: Two cups. I packed two before we argued.
They fit inside each other. They always have.
I'm keeping hers. She can be angry and still be thirsty.

gloves.text: She knitted these too small. I said they were perfect.
If I put them on, she'll know I needed something from her.
My hands are freezing. That is a stupid reason not to wear gloves.

note.text: I wrote don't turn around. I meant don't come after me just because you're afraid.
No. That's not what the page says now.
I want her to come because she wants me. Not because she cannot bear an empty room.

fire.text: The fire's gone low. I didn't walk all this way to freeze for spite.
There. That'll hold till dark, at least.
Funny. I can keep a fire alive out here easier than I kept anything at home.

mend.text: Wind's worked this knot loose. One more gust and the whole side comes down.
There. Tight enough to hold. Everything should be this simple to fix.
I can mend a tent. I could never mend an argument.

photograph.text: There's something else in here. Under the map.
A photograph. The two of us, before either of us knew how to be unkind.
I didn't know I'd packed this. Or I did, and I didn't want to know I had.

lantern.text: There's the window. She left the lantern burning.
A light is not an apology. I know. I'm watching it anyway.
Ophelia. You can leave the house. It won't fall down without you.

road.text: The engine was running when I got here. Nobody was in the seat.
I don't remember starting it. I remember the key in my hand.
I could leave. That is different from wanting to.

house.text: The door is unlatched. She never leaves it like that.
I know which board complains. I know how to come home quietly.
I won't make her guess what I need this time.

snow.text: My prints stop before I do. I'm still walking.
Something called her name with my mouth closed.
If the trees answer, let them. They don't get to choose for me.

idle.text: She thinks brave means not being frightened. It means going out frightened.
She cuts the crusts off when she thinks I'm not looking.
I can hear the house from here. Or I know it too well.
Same afternoon. I have been waiting through the same afternoon.
I left the pack where she could find it. I did not leave it for the trees.
Don't call me back just to put me away again.
Two chairs. Two cups. She remembers in objects before she remembers in words.
I can go back without taking back everything I said.

cold.text: The canvas keeps the wind off. Not the cold.
I thought anger would keep me warm longer than this.

ending.text: I'm coming back. You will have to hear me this time.
I will wait a little longer. But I am not disappearing for her.
